A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] '''warlord''' participated in the [[Battle of Althir (second)|Battle of Althir]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] fragment was discovered that was traced back to the warlord, and led to records of his conquests and treasures.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Shattered Armor}}</ref>
